item.title: How to Beat The Deer in 99 Nights in the Forest — Full Strategy
item.description: The Deer is the signature threat of 99 Nights in the Forest — it circles your campfire and punishes anyone who wanders into the dark. You don’t need to out-fight it early; you need to out-position it. How The Deer behaves Circles the fire — it patrols the perimeter of your light, waiting for a gap. Attacks darkness — anyone outside the campfire radius becomes its priority target. Minions — it directs Cultists and can be accompanied by them on later nights.
